scope: Single-node API-accepted steady load; different durability contracts; excludes ramps, HA and long-running production maintenance
aggregation: Median, minimum, maximum and each of three paired 60-second repetitions; no confidence intervals

runner.pairing: Both backends sequentially on each fresh VM, alternating order across three fresh deployment pairs

dataset.other_signals: deployment-envelope dataset; profile units=nanoseconds, unquoted legacy labels, sampleRate=1e9

source_scope: All four signals use the same independently verified release image from qualified_revision. Harness commits may differ; each is recorded per signal. Diagnostic profiles do not contribute comparison metrics.
